# SintBot

> Connect your project group to Claude Code or Codex. Use Claude, GPT, or GLM, MiniMax and DeepSeek through Claude Code; keep project files and shared notes on your own machine.

Generated from https://sintbot.com/ by scripts/build-zh.mjs — the same facts as the page.

## FAQ

### What is SintBot?

A coding assistant that connects a project group to Claude Code or Codex on your own machine. Give it tasks in the group, choose the agent and model, and keep project files and saved notes together.

### Which chat platforms can I use?

SintBot connects to Feishu groups, Slack channels and WeCom groups. Each group binds to a project, with progress and results returned in the conversation.

### How do teams manage projects?

Bind each group to its own project directory and configure its agent, model and permissions. Use the console to review group status, running tasks, queues and schedules.

### Does everything work offline?

No. SintBot and the project run on your machine, but the chat platform and configured model services require a network connection. Model requests follow the selected agent’s configuration and the service provider’s data policy.

### What do I need to install it?

A Mac with Node.js 22+, an installed and signed-in Codex, and a Feishu China application configured according to the linked installation guide.

### How is SintBot licensed?

SintBot is distributed under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. The package includes its built-in core, the license and third-party notices. Model service access is configured separately.

### Which models can SintBot use?

Use Claude through Claude Code, GPT through Codex, or configure compatible endpoints and your own API keys in Claude Code for GLM, MiniMax and DeepSeek. Kimi and other compatible services can use custom endpoints.

### What stays when I switch models?

Project files and saved shared notes remain. Switching starts a fresh conversation; record decisions and unfinished work in the project so the next agent can read them and continue.

## 中文

> 把项目群接入 Claude Code 或 Codex，可选 Claude、GPT，也可通过 Claude Code 接入 GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek 等模型。项目文件与共享记忆保留在自己的机器上。

## 常见问题

### SintBot 是什么？

把项目群连接到自己机器上的 Claude Code 或 Codex 的编码助手。在群里派活，按任务选择执行器与模型，让代码、素材和已保存的项目记忆留在同一个项目里。

### 可以接入哪些聊天平台？

SintBot 可接入飞书群、Slack 频道和企业微信群。每个群绑定自己的项目，任务进度和结果回到原来的对话里。

### 多个项目如何管理？

每个群绑定独立的项目目录，配置自己的执行器、模型和权限。在控制台查看各群状态、正在执行的任务、消息队列和定时安排。

### 全部处理都在离线环境完成吗？

不是。SintBot 和项目在本机运行，聊天平台及配置的模型服务仍需联网。模型请求遵循所选执行器的配置及服务商的数据政策。

### 安装需要准备什么？

一台已安装 Node.js 22 及以上的 Mac、已安装并登录的 Codex，以及按安装指南配置好的飞书中国版应用。

### SintBot 使用什么许可证？

SintBot 按 PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 分发。安装包包含内置核心、许可证与第三方声明，模型服务需要另行配置。

### SintBot 可以使用哪些模型？

通过 Claude Code 使用 Claude，通过 Codex 使用 GPT；也可在 Claude Code 中配置兼容端点和自己的 API Key，接入 GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek。Kimi 等兼容服务可使用自定义端点。

### 换模型之后，什么会保留？

项目文件和已保存的共享笔记保留。切换会开启新对话；把决定和待办写进项目，下一位助手即可读取记录，接着推进。
